
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/is81/p/22216403" title="发布于 2026-08-04 17:47">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">💊 Sig — 花半天做了个用药提醒APP</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804163607706-926323397.png" alt="&amp;#128138; Sig — 花半天做了个用药提醒APP" class="desc_img">
        Sig is a simple, caring medication reminder that lives on your phone. Set up your meds in seconds, get gentle nudges when it's time, and share it with family — each person's data stays private. No complex setup required. Just you, your health, and a little digital nudge.
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p><em>Built with Claude Code, one morning at a time.</em></p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="起点">起点</h2>
<p>2026 年 8 月 4 日早上，我想做个用药提醒——妈妈总忘记吃药。</p>
<p>第一个版本就是 <code>sig/index.html</code>，纯前端：localStorage 存数据，浏览器 Notification API 发通知。单文件搞定，CSS 暗色模式、手机适配、动画全都塞进去了。</p>
<p><img alt="0开始" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172646493-275651728.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>但单页应用有天花板——页面关了通知就没了；只能一个人用；数据清缓存就丢。</p>
<p><strong>所以决定重写：Node.js + SQLite 后端，多用户，Web Push 通知。</strong></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="搭建">搭建</h2>
<p>Claude Code 先生成了一份详细的实施计划，然后把整个项目拆成了后端基础设施：</p>
<p><img alt="1计划" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172655560-1745163717.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>Express 服务入口</li>
<li>SQLite 数据库（sql.js，纯 WebAssembly，零编译依赖）</li>
<li>JWT 注册/登录</li>
<li>提醒 CRUD API</li>
<li>Web Push 调度器</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="3开工" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172705692-1375430388.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>依赖装好，服务器跑起来——</p>
<p><img alt="4装依赖" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172714843-1749526990.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>一口气写完所有路由、中间件、服务层，前端从 localStorage 改成 fetch API。pm2 启动，IIS 反向代理配好。</p>
<p><img alt="5准备收尾" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172724410-1864329464.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="6做好了" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172732189-1548422286.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>一边试用一边修修 bug</p>
<p><img alt="8发现bug" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172743003-1111189677.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="第一次部署">第一次部署</h2>
<p>部署到 Windows Server + IIS 的生产环境：静态文件走 IIS，<code>/api/*</code> 反向代理到 Node.js 3001 端口，pm2 保活。</p>
<p><img alt="9部署到服务器" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172753262-218309854.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>部署成功，访问 <code>https://is81.net/sig/</code>，注册、添加提醒、标记已服——全部正常。</p>
<p><img alt="10部署总结" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172800825-603779687.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="代码审查--打磨">代码审查 &amp; 打磨</h2>
<p>Claude Code 做了一次 7 角度全量代码审查，找出 10 个问题——从 <code>MAX(id)</code> 竞态到 PUT 操作丢失 taken 状态，从 XSS 到 N+1 查询。逐项修完，一会会就十项清零。</p>
<p><img alt="11代码审查" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172811366-128829797.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="12代码审查结果" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172819037-1239607793.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="14修复汇总" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172826754-830895290.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="国际化">国际化</h2>
<p>"用药助手"的用户不只有中文用户。加上了四国语言： 🇨🇳 中文 · 🇬🇧 English · 🇯🇵 日本語 · 🇪🇸 Español</p>
<p>40+ 条 UI 文案，<code>Intl.DateTimeFormat</code> 自动本地化日期格式，语言偏好存 localStorage，切换即时生效。</p>
<p><img alt="15增加语言支持" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172840726-627650295.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="16语言加好了" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172849007-875674824.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="web-push-调试">Web Push 调试</h2>
<p>通知是整个项目最核心的功能。部署后测试——提醒到时间了，手机没反应。</p>
<p>排查过程一波三折：</p>
<ol>
<li>旧订阅密钥不匹配 → 清空重建</li>
<li>ES 模块 import 在 <code>.env</code> 加载前执行 → VAPID 密钥永远空值 → 改为懒加载</li>
<li>最终加上 <code>/api/push/test</code> 调试端点，<code>sent: 1</code> 那一刻——</li>
</ol>
<p>手机响了。</p>
<p><img alt="17修bug" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172858059-99008688.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="成品">成品</h2>
<p>iPhone 从 Safari 添加到主屏幕，就是一个原生 App 的体验。</p>
<p><img alt="22添加共享" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172916486-1501886095.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="23" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172923306-66548222.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="24添加信息" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172928722-488988381.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="18登录" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172940514-367028213.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="25开启提醒" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804172934516-2105681167.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="19添加药品" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3824995/202608/3824995-20260804173016701-1447766689.jpg" class="lazyload"><br>

<hr>
<h2 id="开源">开源</h2>
<p>项目以 MIT 协议开源在 <a href="https://github.com/is81/sig" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">github.com/is81/sig</a>。</p>
<blockquote>
<p><em>Sig is a simple, caring medication reminder that lives on your phone. Set up your meds in seconds, get gentle nudges when it's time, and share it with family — each person's data stays private. No complex setup required. Just you, your health, and a little digital nudge.</em></p>
</blockquote>
